name: Yirgacheffe Dawn
description: A bright, floral single origin picked at peak ripeness in the highlands of Gedeo. Washed for clarity, roasted light to preserve its citrus lift and tea-like body.

name: Huila Midnight
description: Fermented in sealed tanks before drying, this lot carries a deep, wine-like fruit character balanced by a cocoa-forward finish. Roasted medium-dark for body.

name: Toraja Longhouse
description: Traditional wet-hulling gives this Sulawesi lot its low acidity and heavy, syrupy body. Dark roasted for a smoky, spice-driven cup that holds up to milk.

name: Tarrazu Sunrise
description: Honey-processed on raised beds above the Los Santos valley. A clean, balanced everyday cup with a sweet, nutty finish. Our most popular roast.

name: Kivu Highlands
description: Grown on volcanic soil beside Lake Kivu, this lot is meticulously hand-sorted. Light roasted to spotlight its crisp, currant-driven acidity.

name: Chiapas Nightfall
description: Sun-dried on patios in the Sierra Madre, this natural-process lot is roasted dark for a bold, low-acid cup with heavy fruit and a smoky finish.
